    40	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for Fact 4.20: evaluation in a fixed
    41	vector preserves operator order. -/
    42	theorem quadratic_form_mono {ι : Type*}
    43	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    44	    {S T : Op ι} (hST : S ≤ T) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    45	    (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState S v)).re ≤
    46	      (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState T v)).re := by
    47	  have hpsd : (T - S).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hST
    48	  have hnonneg := hpsd.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
    49	  have hdiff : 0 ≤ (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState (T - S) v)).re := by
    50	    simp only [applyOperatorToState, Matrix.toEuclideanLin,
    51	      Matrix.toLpLin_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    52	    rw [dotProduct_comm]
    53	    exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hnonneg).1
    54	  rw [show T = S + (T - S) by abel]
    55	  simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, inner_add_right,
    56	    Complex.add_re]
    57	  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right hdiff

    59	/-- Applying a product of operators agrees with successive application. -/
    60	private theorem applyOperatorToState_mul {ι : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    62	    (M N : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    63	    applyOperatorToState (M * N) v =
    64	      applyOperatorToState M (applyOperatorToState N v) := by
    65	  unfold applyOperatorToState
    66	  simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]

    68	/-- Finite-subset form of contraction by square-summable left multipliers. -/
    69	private theorem finset_sum_norm_mul_apply_le {γ ι : Type*}
    70	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    71	    (s : Finset γ) (C : γ → Op ι) (D : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
    72	    (hC : ∑ c ∈ s, (C c)ᴴ * C c ≤ 1) :
    73	    ∑ c ∈ s, ‖applyOperatorToState (C c * D) v‖ ^ 2 ≤
    74	      ‖applyOperatorToState D v‖ ^ 2 := by
    75	  calc
    76	    ∑ c ∈ s, ‖applyOperatorToState (C c * D) v‖ ^ 2 =
    77	        ∑ c ∈ s,
    78	          (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState D v)
    79	            (applyOperatorToState ((C c)ᴴ * C c)
    80	              (applyOperatorToState D v))).re := by
    81	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    82	          intro c _
    83	          rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]
    84	          exact norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq (C c) _
    85	    _ = (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState D v)
    86	          (applyOperatorToState (∑ c ∈ s, (C c)ᴴ * C c)
    87	            (applyOperatorToState D v))).re := by
    88	          simp [applyOperatorToState]
    89	    _ ≤ (inner ℂ (applyOperatorToState D v)
    90	          (applyOperatorToState (1 : Op ι) (applyOperatorToState D v))).re :=
    91	      quadratic_form_mono hC _
    92	    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState D v‖ ^ 2 := by
    93	      simpa [applyOperatorToState] using
    94	        (norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq (1 : Op ι) (applyOperatorToState D v)).symm

    97	of left multipliers contracts total squared norm. -/
    98	theorem sum_norm_mul_apply_le {γ ι : Type*}
    99	    [Fintype γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   100	    (C : γ → Op ι) (D : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
   101	    (hC : ∑ c : γ, (C c)ᴴ * C c ≤ 1) :
   102	    ∑ c : γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (C c * D) v‖ ^ 2 ≤
   103	      ‖applyOperatorToState D v‖ ^ 2 := by

   108	the associated squared-norm sum. -/

   110	    [Fintype α] [Fintype Γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   111	    (eval : Γ → α) (S : Γ → Op ι) (D : α → Op ι)
   112	    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hS : ∑ g : Γ, (S g)ᴴ * S g ≤ 1) :
   113	    ∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S g * D (eval g)) v‖ ^ 2 ≤
   114	      ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (D a) v‖ ^ 2 := by
   115	  classical
   116	  rw [show (∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S g * D (eval g)) v‖ ^ 2) =
   117	      ∑ a : α, ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => eval g = a),
   118	        ‖applyOperatorToState (S g * D a) v‖ ^ 2 by
   119	    calc
   120	      _ = ∑ a : α, ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => eval g = a),

   122	        (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ eval
   123	          (fun g => ‖applyOperatorToState (S g * D (eval g)) v‖ ^ 2)).symm
   124	      _ = _ := by

   126	        intro a _

   171	    (∑ a ∈ s, P a * D a)ᴴ * (∑ a ∈ s, P a * D a) =
   172	      ∑ a ∈ s, (D a)ᴴ * P a * D a := by
   173	  classical
   174	  let T : α → Op ι := fun a => P a * D a
   175	  have hstar (a : α) : (P a)ᴴ = P a := by
   176	    simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using (hproj a).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq

   178	    _ = (∑ a ∈ s, (T a)ᴴ) * (∑ b ∈ s, T b) := by
   179	      simp only [T, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
   180	    _ = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ b ∈ s, (T a)ᴴ * T b := by
   181	      rw [Matrix.sum_mul]
   182	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   183	      intro a _
   184	      rw [Matrix.mul_sum]

def paddedProdShuffle {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*} {nA nB : ℕ}
    (eA : κA ≃ ιA × (Fin nA → Bool))
    (eB : κB ≃ ιB × (Fin nB → Bool)) :
    κA × κB ≃ (ιA × ιB) × ((Fin nA → Bool) × (Fin nB → Bool)) :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr eA eB).trans prodShuffle

    74	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]

    76	    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    77	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA ι)

    82	  let leftData : (x : QuestionA) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA ι :=
    83	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData A

    85	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData B

    99	/-! ### Full tensor-product Naimark interface -/
   100	
   101	/-- The single auxiliary Hilbert space used by the full Naimark assembly on one side.
   102	
   103	The one-measurement theorem produces projectors on `H × Option Outcome`.  Since
   104	all questions on one side have the same outcome type, the different question
   105	measurements may be represented on the same auxiliary space, with a different
   106	Naimark unitary for each question. -/
   107	def oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace (Outcome : Type u)
   108	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   109	    FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} where
   110	  carrier := Option Outcome
   111	  instFintype := inferInstance
   112	  instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   113	  instNonempty := ⟨none⟩
   114	
   115	/-- The distinguished auxiliary basis state `|⊥⟩` for the one-register Naimark
   116	assembly. -/
   117	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxPureState (Outcome : Type u)
   118	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   119	    PureState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   120	  PureState.basis (none : Option Outcome)
   121	
   122	/-- The normalized auxiliary density state `|⊥⟩⟨⊥|`. -/
   123	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxState (Outcome : Type u)
   124	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   125	    QuantumState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   126	  oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome
   127	
   128	/-- The one-register auxiliary state is normalized. -/
   129	theorem oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized (Outcome : Type u)
   130	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   131	    (oneNaimarkAuxState Outcome).IsNormalized := by
   132	  exact PureState.toQuantumState_isNormalized (oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome)
   133	
   134	/-- The one-measurement preservation identity identifies the `⊥,⊥`
   135	compression block of the dilated projector with the original effect. -/
   136	theorem OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none
   137	    {Outcome : Type u} [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   138	    {d : Type u} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   139	    (data : OneMeasNaimarkData Outcome d) (a : Outcome) (i j : d) :
   140	    data.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   141	      data.source.effect a i j := by
   142	  classical
   143	  letI : Nonempty d := ⟨i⟩
   144	  have h := data.expectation_preservation (Matrix.single j i (1 : ℂ)) a
   145	  unfold oneMeasLiftedDensity MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace at h
   146	  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.kronecker, naimarkAuxProjector,
   147	    Matrix.single, Fintype.sum_prod_type] at h
   148	  have hd : (Fintype.card d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   149	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
   150	  have hOutcome : (Fintype.card (Option Outcome) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   151	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
   152	  field_simp [hd, hOutcome] at h
   153	  have hsum_if_pair_eq :
   154	      ∀ F : d → d → ℂ,
   155	        (∑ x : d, ∑ y : d, if j = x ∧ i = y then F y x else 0) = F i j := by
   156	    intro F
   157	    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
   158	    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
   159	      · simp
   160	      · intro y _ hyi
   161	        simp [show i ≠ y by exact fun h => hyi h.symm]
   162	      · intro hi
   163	        simp at hi
   164	    · intro x _ hxj
   165	      simp [show j ≠ x by exact fun h => hxj h.symm]
   166	    · intro hj
   167	      simp at hj
   168	  rw [hsum_if_pair_eq (fun y x => data.source.effect a y x)] at h
   169	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h
   170	  rw [hsum_if_pair_eq (fun y x => data.liftedEffect (some a) (y, none) (x, none))] at h
   171	  have hc : (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   172	    positivity
   173	  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc (by
   174	    calc
   175	      (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) *
   176	          data.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   177	        data.source.effect a i j * (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) := h.symm
   178	      _ = (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) * data.source.effect a i j := by ring)
   179	
   180	/-- The two-sided trace identity for the full tensor-product Naimark assembly.
   181	
   182	Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:161-187`, where the
   183	one-measurement helper is applied on Alice's and Bob's sides and then tensored
   184	with the auxiliary state.  The one-measurement theorem already gives the local
   185	compression identity for every test operator.  The statement below isolates the
   186	standard four-register trace calculation which turns the two local compression
   187	identities into preservation of bipartite correlations. -/
   188	theorem OneMeasNaimarkData.twoSidedCorrelationPreservation
   189	    {OutcomeA OutcomeB : Type u}
   190	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
   191	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
   192	    (HA HB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   193	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   194	    (leftData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   195	    (rightData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   196	    (a : OutcomeA) (b : OutcomeB) :
   197	    ev ψ (opTensor (leftData.source.effect a) (rightData.source.effect b)) =
   198	      ev
   199	        (naimarkProductExtensionState HA HB
   200	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA)
   201	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB)
   202	          ψ
   203	          (QuantumState.tensor
   204	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeA)
   205	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeB)))
   206	        (opTensor
   207	          ((leftData.toProjSubMeas).outcome a)
   208	          ((rightData.toProjSubMeas).outcome b)) := by
   209	  classical
   210	  have hleft_comp :
   211	      ∀ i j : HA.carrier,
   212	        leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   213	          leftData.source.effect a i j :=
   214	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none leftData a
   215	  have hright_comp :
   216	      ∀ i j : HB.carrier,
   217	        rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (i, none) (j, none) =
   218	          rightData.source.effect b i j :=
   219	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none rightData b
   220	  unfold ev
   221	  congr 1
   222	  unfold MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   223	  simp [naimarkProductExtensionState, naimarkProductExtensionDensity,
   224	    QuantumState.tensor, oneNaimarkAuxState, oneNaimarkAuxPureState,
   225	    PureState.density, pureDensity, PureState.basis, Matrix.mul_apply,
   226	    Matrix.trace, opTensor, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.vecMulVec]
   227	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, OneMeasNaimarkData.toProjSubMeas,
   228	    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
   229	  field_simp
   230	  let cA : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA).carrier
   231	  let cB : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB).carrier
   232	  let S : ℂ :=
   233	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   234	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   235	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   236	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   237	            ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   238	              leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   239	              rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1
   240	  change S * cA * cB =
   241	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   242	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   243	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   244	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   245	            cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   246	              leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   247	              rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)
   248	  rw [show
   249	      (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   250	        ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   251	          ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   252	            ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   253	              cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   254	                leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   255	                rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)) =
   256	        cA * cB * S by
   257	      calc
   258	        (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   259	          ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   260	            ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   261	              ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   262	                cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   263	                  leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   264	                  rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none))
   265	            = ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   266	              ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   267	                ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   268	                  ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   269	                    cA * cB *
   270	                      (ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   271	                        leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   272	                        rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1) := by
   273	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   274	              intro x _
   275	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   276	              intro x_1 _
   277	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   278	              intro x_2 _
   279	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   280	              intro x_3 _
   281	              rw [hleft_comp x_2 x, hright_comp x_3 x_1]
   282	              ring
   283	        _ = cA * cB * S := by
   284	              simp [S, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]]
   285	  ring_nf
   286	
   287	/-- Full tensor-product Naimark correlation theorem.
   288	
   289	This is the Lean statement corresponding to
   290	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:36-80`
   291	(`\label{thm:naimark}`).  It is proved from the checked one-measurement
   292	Naimark construction and the two-sided trace identity
   293	`OneMeasNaimarkData.twoSidedCorrelationPreservation`. -/
   294	theorem naimarkTensorProductCorrelation
   295	    {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type u}
   296	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
   297	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
   298	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
   299	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
   300	    (HA HB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   301	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   302	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   303	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB HB.carrier) :
   304	    NaimarkTensorProductCorrelationStatement HA HB ψ A B := by
   305	  classical
   306	  intro hψ
   307	  let HauxA : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} := oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA
   308	  let HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} := oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB
   309	  let auxLeft : QuantumState HauxA.carrier := oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeA
   310	  let auxRight : QuantumState HauxB.carrier := oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeB
   311	  let auxState : QuantumState (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier) :=
   312	    QuantumState.tensor auxLeft auxRight
   313	  let leftData : (x : QuestionA) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA HA.carrier :=
   314	    fun x => Classical.choose <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   315	      effect := (A x).outcome
   316	      pos := (A x).outcome_pos
   317	      sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
   318	    } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   319	  let rightData : (y : QuestionB) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB HB.carrier :=
   320	    fun y => Classical.choose <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   321	      effect := (B y).outcome
   322	      pos := (B y).outcome_pos
   323	      sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one B y
   324	    } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   325	  have hleft : ∀ x : QuestionA, (leftData x).source.effect = (A x).outcome := by
   326	    intro x
   327	    simpa [leftData] using congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect <|
   328	      Classical.choose_spec <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   329	        effect := (A x).outcome
   330	        pos := (A x).outcome_pos
   331	        sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
   332	      } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   333	  have hright : ∀ y : QuestionB, (rightData y).source.effect = (B y).outcome := by
   334	    intro y
   335	    simpa [rightData] using congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect <|
   336	      Classical.choose_spec <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   337	        effect := (B y).outcome
   338	        pos := (B y).outcome_pos
   339	        sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one B y
   340	      } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   341	  have hauxLeft : auxLeft.IsNormalized := by
   342	    simpa [auxLeft, HauxA] using oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized OutcomeA
   343	  have hauxRight : auxRight.IsNormalized := by
   344	    simpa [auxRight, HauxB] using oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized OutcomeB
   345	  have hauxState : auxState.IsNormalized := by
   346	    exact QuantumState.tensor_isNormalized hauxLeft hauxRight
   347	  refine ⟨HauxA, HauxB, ⟨?_⟩⟩
   348	  exact {
   349	    auxState := auxState
   350	    auxState_normalized := hauxState
   351	    auxLeft := auxLeft
   352	    auxRight := auxRight
   353	    auxLeft_normalized := hauxLeft
   354	    auxRight_normalized := hauxRight
   355	    auxState_product := rfl
   356	    dilatedState := naimarkProductExtensionState HA HB HauxA HauxB ψ auxState
   357	    dilatedState_density := rfl
   358	    dilatedState_normalized :=
   359	      naimarkProductExtensionState_isNormalized HA HB HauxA HauxB hψ hauxState
   360	    left := fun x => (leftData x).toProjSubMeas
   361	    right := fun y => (rightData y).toProjSubMeas
   362	    correlation_preservation := fun x y a b => by
   363	      simpa [HauxA, HauxB, auxLeft, auxRight, auxState, hleft x, hright y] using
   364	        OneMeasNaimarkData.twoSidedCorrelationPreservation HA HB ψ
   365	          (leftData x) (rightData y) a b
   366	  }
   367

    39	/-! ### One-measurement Naimark statement -/
    40	
    41	/-- Statement of the one-measurement Naimark lemma (Lemma 5.2).
    42	
    43	For any submeasurement `M` on `Op d`, there exists a one-measurement
    44	Naimark dilation on the enlarged space `Op (d × Option α)`. -/
    45	def OneMeasNaimarkLemma (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    46	    (d : Type*) [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    47	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement α d) : Prop :=
    48	  ∃ data : OneMeasNaimarkData α d, data.source = M
    49	
    50	/-! ### Questionwise Naimark interface -/
    51	
    52	/-- Paper origin: Lean-only questionwise interface below
    53	`docs/paper-gaps/naimark-dilation.tex`.
    54	
    55	The paper's full tensor-product Naimark dilation
    56	(`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:36-115`,
    57	`\label{thm:naimark}`) is formalized separately by
    58	`NaimarkTensorProductCorrelationStatement`.  This structure records the
    59	per-question one-measurement dilations of
    60	`\label{lem:naimark-helper}`
    61	(`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`) together with the
    62	single-outcome marginal-preservation conclusions used by downstream
    63	projectivization arguments.
    64	
    65	This records the questionwise one-measurement Naimark dilations that appear in
    66	the proof of the full theorem: each `A x` and `B y` is equipped with a local
    67	projective dilation preserving all single-outcome expectations. The
    68	tensor-product assembly of the paper theorem is the separate source-facing
    69	theorem `naimarkTensorProductCorrelation`. -/
    70	structure NaimarkStatement {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type*}
    71	    {ι : Type*}
    72	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
    73	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
    74	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
    75	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
    76	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    77	    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    78	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA ι)
    79	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB ι)
    80	    (data : NaimarkData QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB ι) : Prop where
    81	  /-- Alice's local dilations are attached to the correct source submeasurements. -/
    82	  leftSource : ∀ x : QuestionA, (data.left x).source.effect = (A x).outcome
    83	  /-- Bob's local dilations are attached to the correct source submeasurements. -/
    84	  rightSource : ∀ y : QuestionB, (data.right y).source.effect = (B y).outcome
    85	  /-- Alice's single-outcome expectations are preserved by each local dilation. -/
    86	  leftMarginalPreservation :
    87	    ∀ x : QuestionA, ∀ (ρ : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (a : OutcomeA),
    88	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (A x).outcome a) =
    89	        MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
    90	          (oneMeasLiftedDensity OutcomeA ρ * (data.left x).liftedEffect (some a))
    91	  /-- Bob's single-outcome expectations are preserved by each local dilation. -/
    92	  rightMarginalPreservation :
    93	    ∀ y : QuestionB, ∀ (ρ : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (b : OutcomeB),
    94	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (B y).outcome b) =
    95	        MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
    96	          (oneMeasLiftedDensity OutcomeB ρ * (data.right y).liftedEffect (some b))
    97	
    98	/-! ### Tensor-product Naimark source theorem -/
    99	
   100	/-- The density matrix of `ψ ⊗ aux`, written in the register order used by the
   101	paper's dilated measurements:
   102	`(Alice × AliceAux) × (Bob × BobAux)`.
   103	
   104	The source paper writes the dilated vector as
   105	`\ket{\widehat{\psi}} = \ket{\psi} \otimes \ket{\mathsf{aux}}`.  Since the
   106	local dilated measurements act on `Alice × AliceAux` and `Bob × BobAux`, the
   107	matrix entries below are the corresponding tensor-product density after the
   108	canonical reassociation and permutation of the four finite registers. -/
   109	noncomputable def naimarkProductExtensionDensity
   110	    (HA HB HauxA HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   111	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   112	    (aux : QuantumState (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) :
   113	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op
   114	      ((HA.carrier × HauxA.carrier) × (HB.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) :=
   115	  fun r c =>
   116	    ψ.density (r.1.1, r.2.1) (c.1.1, c.2.1) *
   117	      aux.density (r.1.2, r.2.2) (c.1.2, c.2.2)
   118	
   119	/-- The canonical register permutation from
   120	`(Alice × Bob) × (AliceAux × BobAux)` to
   121	`(Alice × AliceAux) × (Bob × BobAux)`. -/
   122	def naimarkProductExtensionEquiv
   123	    (HA HB HauxA HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u}) :
   124	    ((HA.carrier × HB.carrier) × (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) ≃
   125	      ((HA.carrier × HauxA.carrier) × (HB.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) :=
   126	  Equiv.prodProdProdComm HA.carrier HB.carrier HauxA.carrier HauxB.carrier
   127	
   128	/-- The product-extension density is the ordinary tensor-product density after
   129	the register permutation used by the dilated measurements. -/
   130	theorem naimarkProductExtensionDensity_eq_reindex_opTensor
   131	    (HA HB HauxA HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   132	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   133	    (aux : QuantumState (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) :
   134	    naimarkProductExtensionDensity HA HB HauxA HauxB ψ aux =
   135	      Matrix.reindex (naimarkProductExtensionEquiv HA HB HauxA HauxB)
   136	        (naimarkProductExtensionEquiv HA HB HauxA HauxB)
   137	        (opTensor ψ.density aux.density) := by
   138	  ext r c
   139	  rfl
   140	
   141	/-- The product-extension density is positive semidefinite. -/
   142	theorem naimarkProductExtensionDensity_nonneg
   143	    (HA HB HauxA HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   144	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   145	    (aux : QuantumState (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier)) :
   146	    0 ≤ naimarkProductExtensionDensity HA HB HauxA HauxB ψ aux := by
   147	  rw [naimarkProductExtensionDensity_eq_reindex_opTensor]
   148	  exact MIPStarRE.Quantum.reindex_nonneg (naimarkProductExtensionEquiv HA HB HauxA HauxB)
   149	    (opTensor_nonneg ψ.density_psd aux.density_psd)

   216	  auxLeft_normalized : auxLeft.IsNormalized
   217	  /-- Bob's auxiliary factor is normalized. -/
   218	  auxRight_normalized : auxRight.IsNormalized

   234	  right : IdxProjSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB (HB.carrier × HauxB.carrier)

    18	/-- The Naimark column acts as an isometry on the input subspace: `VP = V`. -/
    19	private lemma oneMeasNaimarkColumn_mul_inputProj
    20	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    21	    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    22	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement α d) :
    23	    oneMeasNaimarkColumn M * oneMeasNaimarkInputProj (α := α) (d := d) =
    24	      oneMeasNaimarkColumn M := by
    25	  ext ⟨d₁, oa₁⟩ ⟨d₂, oa₂⟩
    26	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, oneMeasNaimarkInputProj,
    27	    oneMeasNaimarkAuxTransition]
    28	  cases oa₂ with
    29	  | none =>
    30	    have : ∀ x : d × Option α,
    31	        oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) x *
    32	          Matrix.kronecker (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op d)
    33	            (Matrix.single (none : Option α) (none : Option α) (1 : ℂ)) x (d₂, none) =
    34	          if x = (d₂, (none : Option α)) then
    35	            oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) (d₂, none)
    36	          else 0 := by
    37	      intro ⟨k₁, k₂⟩
    38	      cases k₂ with
    39	      | none =>
    40	          by_cases h : k₁ = d₂ <;>
    41	            simp [Matrix.kronecker, Prod.ext_iff, h]
    42	      | some a =>
    43	          have hneq : (k₁, some a) ≠ (d₂, (none : Option α)) := by
    44	            intro h
    45	            cases h
    46	          simp [Matrix.kronecker, hneq]
    47	    simp_rw [this]
    48	    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (d₂, (none : Option α)) (fun _ =>
    49	      oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) (d₂, none))]
    50	    simp
    51	  | some a₂ =>
    52	    simp [oneMeasNaimarkColumn, Matrix.kronecker]

    54	-- This is independent of Naimark and could be moved to `LDT/Preliminaries`.
    55	/-- **Partial isometry to unitary extension** (general fact).
    56	
    57	If `V†V = P` where `P` is a projection and `V = VP`, then there exists
    58	a unitary `U` on the full space with `UP = V`.
    59	
    60	This is a standard result in finite-dimensional linear algebra: V is an
    61	isometry from range(P) to V's range, and in finite dimensions any
    62	isometry between subspaces extends to a unitary.
    63	
    64	**Mathlib route**: `LinearIsometry.extend` provides the extension for
    65	linear isometries between inner product spaces. The gap is the
    66	matrix-to-`EuclideanSpace` transport. -/
    67	private lemma partialIsometry_to_unitary
    68	    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    69	    (V P : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n)
    70	    (hP : MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj P)
    71	    (hVP : V * P = V)
    72	    (hVV : Vᴴ * V = P) :
    73	    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
    74	      (U : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n) * P = V := by
    75	  classical
    76	  have toEuclideanLin_mul :
    77	      ∀ A B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n,
    78	        Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A * B) =
    79	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).comp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) := by
    80	    intro A B
    81	    simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same (p := (2 : ENNReal)) A B]
    82	  let Pₗ : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := Matrix.toEuclideanLin P
    83	  let Vₗ : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := Matrix.toEuclideanLin V
    84	  let S : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := LinearMap.range Pₗ
    85	  letI : InnerProductSpace ℂ S := Submodule.innerProductSpace S
    86	  have hP_fix : ∀ x : S, Pₗ (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) = x := by
    87	    intro x
    88	    rcases x.2 with ⟨y, hy⟩
    89	    rw [← hy]
    90	    calc
    91	      Pₗ (Pₗ y) = (Pₗ.comp Pₗ) y := rfl
    92	      _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (P * P) y := by rw [toEuclideanLin_mul]
    93	      _ = Pₗ y := by rw [hP.isIdempotentElem.eq]
    94	  have hVP_lin : Vₗ.comp Pₗ = Vₗ := by
    95	    calc
    96	      Vₗ.comp Pₗ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (V * P) := by rw [toEuclideanLin_mul]
    97	      _ = Vₗ := by rw [hVP]
    98	  have hgram : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Vᴴ * V) = Pₗ := by
    99	    calc
   100	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Vᴴ * V) = Matrix.toEuclideanLin P := by rw [hVV]
   101	      _ = Pₗ := rfl
   102	  let Llin : S →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := Vₗ.comp S.subtype
   103	  have hLnorm : ∀ x : S, ‖Llin x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
   104	    exact (LinearMap.norm_map_iff_inner_map_map
   105	      (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := S) (E' := EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
   106	      (F := S →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n) Llin).2 fun x y => by
   107	      have hy : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Vᴴ * V) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) = y := by
   108	        calc
   109	          Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Vᴴ * V) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) =
   110	              Pₗ (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := by rw [hgram]
   111	          _ = y := hP_fix y
   112	      calc
   113	        inner ℂ (Llin x) (Llin y) =
   114	            inner ℂ (Vₗ (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) (Vₗ (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) := rfl
   115	        _ = inner ℂ (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
   116	            (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Vᴴ * V) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) := by
   117	          dsimp [Vₗ]
   118	          rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
   119	          exact (LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (𝕜 := ℂ)
   120	            (Matrix.toEuclideanLin V) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)
   121	            (Matrix.toEuclideanLin V (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n))).symm
   122	        _ = inner ℂ (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := by rw [hy]
   123	        _ = inner ℂ x y := rfl
   124	  let L : S →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := { toLinearMap := Llin, norm_map' := hLnorm }
   125	  let Ulin : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n :=
   126	    LinearIsometry.extend (𝕜 := ℂ) (V := EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (S := S) L
   127	  let Umat : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n :=
   128	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm Ulin.toLinearMap
   129	  have hUmat_lin : Matrix.toEuclideanLin Umat = Ulin.toLinearMap := by
   130	    exact Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply Ulin.toLinearMap
   131	  have hUstarU : Umatᴴ * Umat = 1 := by
   132	    apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   133	    calc
   134	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Umatᴴ * Umat) =
   135	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Umat).adjoint.comp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Umat) := by
   136	            rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
   137	      _ = Ulin.toLinearMap.adjoint.comp Ulin.toLinearMap := by rw [hUmat_lin]
   138	      _ = 1 := by exact Ulin.adjoint_comp_self'
   139	      _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n) := by
   140	            rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]
   141	            rfl
   142	  let U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ := ⟨Umat, (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff').2 hUstarU⟩
   143	  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
   144	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   145	  apply LinearMap.ext
   146	  intro x
   147	  have hExt : Ulin (Pₗ x) = Vₗ (Pₗ x) := by
   148	    simpa [Ulin, L, Llin] using
   149	      (LinearIsometry.extend_apply L ⟨Pₗ x, LinearMap.mem_range_self Pₗ x⟩)
   150	  calc
   151	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((U : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n) * P) x =
   152	        Matrix.toEuclideanLin Umat (Pₗ x) := by
   153	          rw [toEuclideanLin_mul]
   154	          rfl
   155	    _ = Ulin (Pₗ x) := by
   156	          rw [hUmat_lin]
   157	          rfl
   158	    _ = Vₗ (Pₗ x) := hExt
   159	    _ = Vₗ x := by
   160	          have hx := congrArg
   161	            (fun f : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n => f x) hVP_lin
   162	          simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx
   163	    _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin V x := rfl

   217	/-- **One-measurement Naimark lemma** (Lemma 5.2).
   218	
   219	For any submeasurement `M : Submeasurement α d`, there exists a projective
   220	submeasurement on the enlarged space `d × Option α` such that for every
   221	operator `ρ` on `Op d` and outcome `a`:
   222	`τ(ρ · M_a) = τ'(ρ_lifted · P̂_a)`
   223	where `ρ_lifted = |Option α| · (ρ ⊗ |⊥⟩⟨⊥|)` and `P̂_a` is the
   224	dilated projector.
   225	
   226	**Proof sketch**: Let `V|ψ⟩ = ∑_a √M_a|ψ⟩ ⊗ |a⟩ + √(I−M)|ψ⟩ ⊗ |⊥⟩`.
   227	This is an isometry (by the submeasurement property `∑ M_a ≤ I`).
   228	Define `P̂_a = V†(I ⊗ |a⟩⟨a|)V`. Then `P̂_a` is an orthogonal projection
   229	(since `|a⟩⟨a|` is), and the compression identity
   230	`(I⊗⟨⊥|) P̂_a (I⊗|⊥⟩) = √M_a · √M_a = M_a` gives the result.
   231	
   232	The proof uses `CFC.sqrt` for PSD operators together with lemmas such as
   233	`CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self`. -/
   234	theorem oneMeasNaimark {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   235	    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   236	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement α d) :
   237	    OneMeasNaimarkLemma α d M := by
   238	  classical
   239	  let auxProj : Option α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (Option α) :=
   240	    fun oa => Matrix.single oa oa 1
   241	  /-
   242	  The prescribed Naimark isometry column:
   243	    `V (|ψ⟩ ⊗ |⊥⟩)
   244	      = ∑_a √(M_a)|ψ⟩ ⊗ |a⟩ + √(I - ∑_a M_a)|ψ⟩ ⊗ |⊥⟩`,
   245	  encoded by `oneMeasNaimarkColumn M`.  Concretely, this matrix is
   246	  supported only on the input `none = ⊥` slice.
   247	  -/
   248	  let V : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (d × Option α) := oneMeasNaimarkColumn M
   249	  /-
   250	  Extend the isometry column `V` to a unitary `U` on the whole enlarged space.
   251	  The dilated projectors are then `U† (I ⊗ |oa⟩⟨oa|) U`.
   252	  -/
   253	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
   254	    partialIsometry_to_unitary
   255	      (oneMeasNaimarkColumn M) (oneMeasNaimarkInputProj (α := α) (d := d))
   256	      oneMeasNaimarkInputProj_isProj
   257	      (oneMeasNaimarkColumn_mul_inputProj M)
   258	      (oneMeasNaimarkColumn_isometry M)
   259	  let Umat : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (d × Option α) := U
   260	  refine ⟨{
   261	    source := M
   262	    liftedEffect := fun oa =>
   263	      Umatᴴ * Matrix.kronecker (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op d) (auxProj oa) * Umat

    14	/-- A PSD density matrix indexed by `ι`.
    15	
    16	There is intentionally no global `Inhabited` instance: the zero matrix is PSD but
    17	not a physical state of unit trace, so an ambient default would silently
    18	trivialize later statements. Use `IsNormalized` to additionally require
    19	`τ(ρ) = 1`.
    20	
    21	This remains the ambient state space for the current LDT development: strategy
    22	packages in `LDT/Test/StrategyCore.lean`, the SWAP-symmetry API `PermInvState`,
    23	and the expectation-value lemmas in `LDT/Basic/OperatorExpectations.lean` are all
    24	stated for arbitrary density matrices, not only pure states. -/
    25	structure QuantumState (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] where
    26	  density : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι := 0
    27	  density_psd : 0 ≤ density := by positivity

    29	/-- Unit normalized trace for the concrete matrix carried by a state. -/
    30	def QuantumState.IsNormalized {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    31	    (ψ : QuantumState ι) : Prop :=
    32	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 1

    34	/-- A normalized state has a nonempty carrier: if the carrier were empty, the
    35	trace would vanish and `normalizedTrace = 0 / 0 = 0`, contradicting `= 1`. -/
    36	theorem QuantumState.IsNormalized.nonempty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    37	    {ψ : QuantumState ι} (hψ : ψ.IsNormalized) : Nonempty ι := by
    38	  by_contra h
    39	  rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    40	  letI := h
    41	  rw [QuantumState.IsNormalized] at hψ
    42	  have hzero : MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 0 := by
    43	    simp [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace]
    44	  exact zero_ne_one (hzero.symm.trans hψ)

    46	/-- The scaled rank-one density matrix attached to a state vector.
    47	
    48	Because this development uses the normalized trace `τ(A) = tr(A) / dim`, the
    49	quantum state represented by a unit vector `ψ` is `dim · |ψ⟩⟨ψ|` rather than the
    50	raw projector `|ψ⟩⟨ψ|`. This scaling makes `τ(ρ) = 1` and keeps `ev` aligned
    51	with the paper's bra-ket expectations. -/
    52	noncomputable def pureDensity {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    53	    (ψ : ι → ℂ) : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
    54	  (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) • Matrix.vecMulVec ψ (star ψ)

   110	theorem normalizedTrace_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   111	    (ψ : PureState ι) :
   112	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ψ.density = 1 := by

   114	  unfold density pureDensity MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   115	  rw [Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm, ψ.unit]
   116	  change ((Fintype.card ι : ℂ) * 1) / (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) = 1
   117	  rw [mul_one, div_self hcard]

   124	theorem normalizedTrace_density_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
   125	    (ψ : PureState ι) (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
   126	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ((ψ : QuantumState ι).density * X) =
   127	      star ψ.vector ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) := by
   128	  have hcard : (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   129	  calc
   130	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace ((ψ : QuantumState ι).density * X)
   131	      = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * (ψ : QuantumState ι).density) := by
   132	          rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace_mul_comm]
   133	    _ = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * ψ.density) := by rfl
   134	    _ = MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   135	          ((Fintype.card ι : ℂ) • (X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector))) := by
   136	          simp [density, pureDensity]
   137	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   138	          MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector)) := by
   139	          rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace_smul]
   140	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   141	          (((X * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ.vector (star ψ.vector)).trace) /
   142	            (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by
   143	          simp [MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace]
   144	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   145	          (((Matrix.vecMulVec (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) (star ψ.vector)).trace) /
   146	            (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by
   147	          rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec]
   148	    _ = (Fintype.card ι : ℂ) *
   149	          (((X *ᵥ ψ.vector) ⬝ᵥ star ψ.vector) / (Fintype.card ι : ℂ)) := by
   150	          rw [Matrix.trace_vecMulVec]
   151	    _ = (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) ⬝ᵥ star ψ.vector := by
   152	          field_simp [hcard]
   153	    _ = star ψ.vector ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ ψ.vector) := by
   154	          rw [dotProduct_comm]

     4	
     5	/-! # State-dependent consistency and strategy closeness
     6	
     7	The definitions are the finite-dimensional forms of `def:consistency` and
     8	`def:strategy-distance` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-237`,
     9	from `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-288`.
    10	-/
    11	
    12	open scoped BigOperators
    13	
    14	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    15	
    16	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    17	
    18	/-- The off-diagonal defect in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    19	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    20	noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    21	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    22	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    23	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    24	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    25	  avgOver μ (fun x =>
    26	    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
    27	      if a = b then 0 else
    28	        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
    29	          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)
    30	
    31	/-- The quantitative relation in `def:consistency`, blueprint
    32	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:195-208`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
    33	def IsConsistentWithin {X α ι : Type*}
    34	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    35	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    36	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
    38	  consistencyDefect μ A B ψ ≤ δ
    39	
    40	/-- Unit-alphabet specialization of `def:povm-distance`, blueprint
    41	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
    42	noncomputable def opDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    43	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    44	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
    45	  opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ
    46	
    47	/-- The unit-alphabet operator distance equals its one-outcome family form from
    48	`def:povm-distance`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:219-226`, paper
    49	`06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
    50	theorem opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    51	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    52	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    53	    opDistSq μ M N ψ = opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x)
    54	      (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ := rfl
    55	
    56	/-- The strategy-distance relation `def:strategy-distance`. The two strategies'
    57	local Hilbert spaces are identified, and both measurement distances are
    58	evaluated on the first strategy's state. Blueprint
    59	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    60	structure AreCloseStrategies (G : Game) (S S' : Strategy G) (δ : ℝ) : Prop where
    61	  /-- Identification of Alice's local Hilbert spaces. -/
    62	  hA : S.ιA = S'.ιA
    63	  /-- Identification of Bob's local Hilbert spaces. -/
    64	  hB : S.ιB = S'.ιB
    65	  state : stateDistSq S.ψ (reindexState
    66	      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.cast hA).symm (Equiv.cast hB).symm) S'.ψ) ≤ δ
    67	  alice : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.fst)
    68	      (fun x a => heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1)
    69	      (fun x a => heteroKron (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hA) ((S'.A x).effect a)) 1)
    70	      S.ψ ≤ δ
    71	  bob : opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.snd)
    72	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b))
    73	      (fun y b => heteroKron 1 (reindexOp (Equiv.cast hB) ((S'.B y).effect b)))
    74	      S.ψ ≤ δ
    75	
    76	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     7	error under `approx_δ` families.
     8	
     9	## References
    10	
    11	- `references/ldt-paper/preliminaries.tex`, `prop:switch-sandwich`
    12	- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch03_preliminaries.tex`

    21	lemma question_overlap_gap_left
    22	    {Outcome : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype Outcome]
    24	    (ψ : QuantumState ι) (hψ : ψ.IsNormalized)
    25	    (A B : SubMeas Outcome ι) :
    26	    |(∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a)) -
    27	        ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ (A.outcome a * B.outcome a)| ≤
    28	      Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) := by
    29	  let diagA : Error := ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a)
    30	  have hdiagA_le_one : diagA ≤ 1 := by
    31	    simpa [diagA] using subMeas_diagMass_le_one ψ hψ A
    32	  have haux :
    33	      |∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a)| ≤
    34	        Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) * Real.sqrt diagA := by
    35	    calc
    36	      |∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a)|
    37	        ≤ ∑ a : Outcome, |ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a)| := by
    38	            exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    39	      _ ≤ ∑ a : Outcome,
    40	            Real.sqrt (ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a)ᴴ * (A.outcome a - B.outcome a))) *
    41	              Real.sqrt (ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a)) := by
    42	            refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    43	            intro a _
    44	            have hherm : (A.outcome a - B.outcome a)ᴴ = A.outcome a - B.outcome a := by
    45	              simp [SubMeas.outcome_hermitian]
    46	            simpa [hherm, SubMeas.outcome_hermitian] using
    47	              ev_abs_mul_le_sqrt ψ (A.outcome a - B.outcome a) (A.outcome a)
    48	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt
    49	            (∑ a : Outcome,
    50	              ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a)ᴴ * (A.outcome a - B.outcome a))) *
    51	          Real.sqrt diagA := by
    52	            simpa [diagA] using
    53	              Real.sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le (s := Finset.univ)
    54	                (f := fun a =>
    55	                  ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a)ᴴ * (A.outcome a - B.outcome a)))
    56	                (g := fun a => ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a))
    57	                (fun a => ev_adjoint_self_nonneg ψ _)
    58	                (fun a => by
    59	                  simpa [SubMeas.outcome_hermitian] using
    60	                    ev_adjoint_self_nonneg ψ (A.outcome a))
    61	      _ = Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) * Real.sqrt diagA := by
    62	            simp [qSDD, qSDDCore, diagA]
    63	  have hsqrtA : Real.sqrt diagA ≤ 1 := by
    64	    simpa using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdiagA_le_one
    65	  have haux' :
    66	      |∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a)| ≤
    67	        Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) := by
    68	    calc
    69	      |∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a)|
    70	        ≤ Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) * Real.sqrt diagA := haux
    71	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) * 1 := by
    72	            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtA (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    73	      _ = Real.sqrt (qSDD ψ A B) := by ring
    74	  convert haux' using 1
    75	  refine congrArg abs ?_
    76	  calc
    77	    ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a) -
    78	        ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ (A.outcome a * B.outcome a)
    79	      = ∑ a : Outcome,
    80	          (ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a) -
    81	            ev ψ (A.outcome a * B.outcome a)) := by
    82	              rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    83	    _ = ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a) := by
    84	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    85	          intro a _
    86	          have hcomm :
    87	              ev ψ (B.outcome a * A.outcome a) = ev ψ (A.outcome a * B.outcome a) := by
    88	            exact ev_mul_comm_of_psd ψ _ _ (B.outcome_pos a) (A.outcome_pos a)
    89	          calc
    90	            ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a) - ev ψ (A.outcome a * B.outcome a)
    91	              = ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a) - ev ψ (B.outcome a * A.outcome a) := by
    92	                  rw [hcomm]
    93	            _ = ev ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a - B.outcome a * A.outcome a) := by
    94	                  rw [(ev_sub ψ (A.outcome a * A.outcome a) (B.outcome a * A.outcome a)).symm]
    95	            _ = ev ψ ((A.outcome a - B.outcome a) * A.outcome a) := by
    96	                  simp [sub_mul]

   173	/-- `prop:easy-approx-from-approx-delta`. -/
   174	theorem easyApproxFromApproxDelta_twoFamily {Question Outcome : Type*}
   175	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   176	    [Fintype Outcome]
   177	    (ψ : QuantumState ι) (𝒟 : Distribution Question)
   178	    (hψ : ψ.IsNormalized)
   179	    (h𝒟 : ∑ q ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight q ≤ 1)
   180	    (A B : IdxSubMeas Question Outcome ι) (δ : Error) :
   181	    SDDRel ψ 𝒟 A B δ →
   182	      |avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A q).outcome a * (A q).outcome a)) -
   183	          avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A q).outcome a * (B q).outcome a))|
   184	          ≤ Real.sqrt δ ∧
   185	      |avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A q).outcome a * (B q).outcome a)) -
   186	          avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((B q).outcome a * (B q).outcome a))|
   187	          ≤ Real.sqrt δ := by
   188	  intro ⟨hδ⟩
   189	  let diagA : Question → Error :=
   190	    fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A q).outcome a * (A q).outcome a)
   191	  let diagB : Question → Error :=
   192	    fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((B q).outcome a * (B q).outcome a)
   193	  let overlap : Question → Error :=
   194	    fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, ev ψ ((A q).outcome a * (B q).outcome a)
   195	  let sdd : Question → Error := fun q => qSDD ψ (A q) (B q)
   196	  have hleft_pointwise : ∀ q, |diagA q - overlap q| ≤ Real.sqrt (sdd q) := by
   197	    intro q
   198	    simpa [diagA, overlap, sdd] using
   199	      question_overlap_gap_left ψ hψ (A q) (B q)
   200	  have hright_pointwise : ∀ q, |overlap q - diagB q| ≤ Real.sqrt (sdd q) := by
   201	    intro q
   202	    simpa [diagB, overlap, sdd] using
   203	      question_overlap_gap_right ψ hψ (A q) (B q)
   204	  constructor
   205	  · calc
   206	      |avgOver 𝒟 diagA - avgOver 𝒟 overlap|
   207	        = |avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => diagA q - overlap q)| := by
   208	            simp [avgOver, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
   209	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 sdd) := by
   210	            exact
   211	              avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟
   212	                (fun q => diagA q - overlap q)
   213	                sdd
   214	                hleft_pointwise
   215	                (fun q => qSDD_nonneg ψ (A q) (B q))
   216	                h𝒟
   217	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt δ := by
   218	            exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hδ
   219	  · calc
   220	      |avgOver 𝒟 overlap - avgOver 𝒟 diagB|
   221	        = |avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => overlap q - diagB q)| := by
   222	            simp [avgOver, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
   223	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 sdd) := by
   224	            exact
   225	              avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟
   226	                (fun q => overlap q - diagB q)
   227	                sdd
   228	                hright_pointwise
   229	                (fun q => qSDD_nonneg ψ (A q) (B q))
   230	                h𝒟
   231	      _ ≤ Real.sqrt δ := by
   232	            exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hδ

    11	lemma weightedFinsetCauchySchwarz
    12	    {Question Outcome : Type*}
    13	    [Fintype Outcome]
    14	    (𝒟 : Distribution Question)
    15	    (t x y : Question → Outcome → Error)
    16	    (ht : ∀ q a, |t q a| ≤ Real.sqrt (x q a) * Real.sqrt (y q a))
    17	    (hx : ∀ q a, 0 ≤ x q a)
    18	    (hy : ∀ q a, 0 ≤ y q a) :
    19	    |avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, t q a)| ≤
    20	      Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, x q a)) *
    21	        Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun q => ∑ a : Outcome, y q a)) := by
    22	  unfold avgOver
    23	  calc
    24	    |∑ q ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight q * ∑ a : Outcome, t q a|
    25	      ≤ ∑ q ∈ 𝒟.support, |𝒟.weight q * ∑ a : Outcome, t q a| := by
    26	          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    27	    _ = ∑ q ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight q * |∑ a : Outcome, t q a| := by
    28	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    29	          intro q _
    30	          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (𝒟.nonnegative q)]
    31	    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ 𝒟.support,
    32	          𝒟.weight q *
    33	            (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Outcome, x q a) *
    34	              Real.sqrt (∑ a : Outcome, y q a)) := by
    35	          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    36	          intro q _

item.text: The core estimate now type-checks cleanly: when one measurement family is projective, changing a family by squared distance `ζ` changes any selected-outcome probability by at most `2√ζ`. Next I’m connecting this lemma to game strategies by lifting the two marginal closeness bounds to their joint measurement.

     4	/-!
     5	# Games, tensor-product strategies, and value
     6	
     7	This file provides the finite game carrier used by the Pauli basis test.  Pure
     8	states are vectors in `EuclideanSpace`, and POVMs use the project's matrix
     9	`Measurement` structure.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The source-facing nodes are `def:game`, `def:povm-conventions`,
    14	`def:tensor-product-strategy`, and `def:tensor-product-value` in
    15	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:47-82` and `8-26`.
    16	The paper origin is `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-57`.
    17	-/

    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    25	
    26	/--
    27	A finite two-player one-round game with a probability distribution on question
    28	pairs and a Boolean decision predicate.  This is `def:game` in
    29	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:51-59`, with paper origin
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-24`.
    31	-/
    32	structure Game where
    33	  QuestionA : Type
    34	  QuestionB : Type
    35	  AnswerA : Type
    36	  AnswerB : Type
    37	  [questionAFintype : Fintype QuestionA]
    38	  [questionBFintype : Fintype QuestionB]
    39	  [answerAFintype : Fintype AnswerA]
    40	  [answerBFintype : Fintype AnswerB]
    41	  [questionADecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionA]
    42	  [questionBDecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionB]
    43	  [answerADecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerA]
    44	  [answerBDecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerB]
    45	  μ : Distribution (QuestionA × QuestionB)
    46	  μ_prob : μ.IsProbability
    47	  decide : QuestionA → QuestionB → AnswerA → AnswerB → Bool
    48	
    49	attribute [instance] Game.questionAFintype Game.questionBFintype
    50	  Game.answerAFintype Game.answerBFintype Game.questionADecidableEq
    51	  Game.questionBDecidableEq Game.answerADecidableEq Game.answerBDecidableEq
    52	
    53	/--

    55	is the POVM convention of `def:povm-conventions` in
    56	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; the post-processing operation

    61	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    63	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement α d :=

    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]

   108	def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=

   115	action underlying `def:tensor-product-value`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-271`. -/
   117	noncomputable def applyOperatorToState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    28	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    29	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    30	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιA) :
    31	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (ιA × ιB) :=
    32	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    33	    (fun a => heteroKron (M.effect a) 1)

import MIPStarRE.Quantum.FiniteMatrix.NormalizedTrace

/-!
# Matrix-valued measurements for the MIP*=RE project

This file provides the matrix-valued measurement layer used by the LDT formalization.

## Main definitions

* `Submeasurement` — a family of PSD matrices summing to at most the identity.
* `Measurement` — a family of PSD matrices summing to exactly the identity.
* `Submeasurement.postprocess` — data-processed submeasurements via answer relabeling.
* `Measurement.postprocess` — the paper's postprocessing proposition for complete POVMs.
* `inconsistency` — the off-diagonal mass `∑_{a ≠ b} τ(M_a N_b)`.
* `diagOverlap` — the diagonal mass `∑_a τ(M_a N_a)`.

## References

This file builds the project's finite-dimensional measurement layer on top of
the normalized-trace and positive-operator facts in `MIPStarRE.Quantum.FiniteMatrix`
for the quantum formalization in `references/ldt-paper/`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-! ## Submeasurements and measurements -/

/--
A submeasurement on a finite answer type `α` is a family of PSD matrices
`M : α → Op d` with `∑ a, M a ≤ 1`.
-/
structure Submeasurement (α : Type*) [Fintype α] (d : Type*) [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] where
  /-- The effect operators. -/
  effect : α → Op d
  /-- Each effect is positive semidefinite. -/
  pos : ∀ a, 0 ≤ effect a
  /-- The effects sum to at most the identity. -/
  sum_le_one : ∑ a, effect a ≤ 1

/--
A measurement is a submeasurement whose effects sum exactly to the identity.
-/
structure Measurement (α : Type*) [Fintype α] (d : Type*) [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    extends Submeasurement α d where
  /-- The effects sum to the identity. -/
  sum_eq_one : ∑ a, effect a = 1

/-! ## Totals and postprocessing -/

namespace Submeasurement

variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
variable {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]

/-! ### Totals and postprocessing -/

/-- The total operator `∑ a, M_a`. -/
noncomputable def total (M : Submeasurement α d) : Op d :=
  ∑ a, M.effect a

/--
Data processing: relabel the answer set by `f : α → β`, summing the effects over
fibers.
-/
noncomputable def postprocess [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Submeasurement α d) (f : α → β) : Submeasurement β d where
  effect b := ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a
  pos b := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => M.pos a
  sum_le_one := by
    calc
      ∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a
          = ∑ a, M.effect a := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f M.effect
      _ ≤ 1 := M.sum_le_one

/-- Restatement of `sum_le_one` in terms of the named total operator. -/
theorem total_le_one (M : Submeasurement α d) :
    M.total ≤ 1 := by
  simpa [total] using M.sum_le_one

/-- Postprocessing preserves the sum of all effects. -/
theorem postprocess_sum_eq [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Submeasurement α d) (f : α → β) :
    ∑ a, M.effect a = ∑ b, (M.postprocess f).effect b :=
  (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f M.effect).symm

/-- Postprocessing preserves the named total operator. -/
theorem postprocess_total [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Submeasurement α d) (f : α → β) :
    (M.postprocess f).total = M.total := by
  simpa [total] using (M.postprocess_sum_eq f).symm

end Submeasurement

namespace Measurement

variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
variable {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]

/--
Build a complete measurement from effects whose sum is exactly the identity.

This constructor keeps the equality proof as the primary hypothesis and derives
the inherited submeasurement inequality automatically.  It is useful at paper
sites that are explicitly POVMs rather than relaxed sub-POVMs.
-/
def ofSumEqOne (effect : α → Op d) (pos : ∀ a, 0 ≤ effect a)
    (sum_eq_one : ∑ a, effect a = 1) : Measurement α d where
  effect := effect
  pos := pos
  sum_le_one := le_of_eq sum_eq_one
  sum_eq_one := sum_eq_one

/-- The named total of a complete measurement is the identity. -/
theorem total_eq_one (M : Measurement α d) :
    M.total = 1 :=
  M.sum_eq_one

/--
Postprocess a complete measurement by relabeling outcomes.

This formalizes `references/ldt-paper/preliminaries.tex:169--180`: regrouping
the effects along the fibers of `f` preserves the total operator, so a POVM
remains a POVM after postprocessing.
-/
noncomputable def postprocess [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Measurement α d) (f : α → β) : Measurement β d where
  toSubmeasurement := M.toSubmeasurement.postprocess f
  sum_eq_one := by
    calc
      ∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a
          = ∑ a, M.effect a := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f M.effect
      _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one

@[simp] theorem postprocess_effect [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Measurement α d) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    (M.postprocess f).effect b =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem postprocess_to_submeasurement [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Measurement α d) (f : α → β) :
    (M.postprocess f).toSubmeasurement = M.toSubmeasurement.postprocess f :=
  rfl

end Measurement

/-! ## Overlap definitions -/

section Overlap

variable {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

/-- The off-diagonal overlap mass `∑_{a ≠ b} τ(M_a N_b)`. -/
noncomputable def inconsistency (M N : α → Op d) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a, ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => b ≠ a), normalizedTrace (M a * N b)

/-- The diagonal overlap mass `∑_a τ(M_a N_a)`. -/
noncomputable def diagOverlap (M N : α → Op d) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a, normalizedTrace (M a * N a)

end Overlap

end MIPStarRE.Quantum

    {A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op d₁} {B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op d₂}

    MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (Matrix.kronecker A B) := by
  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }

      cases i with

          cases j with

/-!
# Finite-dimensional state transformations

This file defines the tensor and reindexing operations used for strategy
distance, Magic Square rigidity, and the qudit-to-qubit isomorphism. See
blueprint chapters 11--13 and the declaration-level references below.
-/

open scoped Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- Conjugation by the local isometries in `thm:ms-rigidity` and
`lem:pauli-binary`; blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244` and
`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:710-741`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652` and
`04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    (M : Op ι) : Op ι' :=
  let U : Matrix ι' ι ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
  U * M * Uᴴ

/-- Coordinate transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι' ℂ).symm
    (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))

/-- Apply the two independent local isometries of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
noncomputable def isometryTensor
    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm
    (fun p =>
      ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κA ℂ)
            (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1) *
          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κB ℂ)
            (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2) *
          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA × ιB) ℂ) ψ (i, j)))

/-- Coordinate tensor used in the ideal state of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
noncomputable def vecTensor {ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × κ) ℂ).symm
    (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ u) p.1 * (EuclideanSpace.equiv κ ℂ v) p.2)

/-- Operator transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
def reindexOp {ι ι' : Type*} (e : ι ≃ ι') (M : Op ι') : Op ι :=
  (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm) M

/-- Four-factor tensor shuffle used by `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
def prodShuffle {α β γ δ : Type*} :
    (α × β) × (γ × δ) ≃ (α × γ) × (β × δ) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

          (2 : Error) • swapDensity

/-- Swap an operator on `ιA × ιB` to one on `ιB × ιA`. -/
noncomputable def heterogeneousSwapDensity {ιA ιB : Type*}
    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιB × ιA) :=
  Matrix.reindex (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) X

/-- **Lean-only:** Tensor products commute with the heterogeneous swap map.

Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex:40-66`; this is the
matrix-index identity used to identify the two role-register sectors in the
heterogeneous symmetrization. -/
@[simp] theorem heterogeneousSwapDensity_opTensor {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ιA) (B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ιB) :
    heterogeneousSwapDensity (opTensor A B) = opTensor B A := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with ⟨iB, iA⟩
  rcases j with ⟨jB, jA⟩
  simp [heterogeneousSwapDensity, opTensor]
  ring

theorem heterogeneousSwapDensity_nonneg {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Finite ιA] [Finite ιB] {X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)}
    (hX : 0 ≤ X) : 0 ≤ heterogeneousSwapDensity X :=
  MIPStarRE.Quantum.reindex_nonneg (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) hX

@[simp] theorem heterogeneousSwapDensity_mul {ιA ιB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    (X Y : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    heterogeneousSwapDensity (X * Y) =
      heterogeneousSwapDensity X * heterogeneousSwapDensity Y := by
  classical
  unfold heterogeneousSwapDensity
  exact map_mul (Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB)) X Y

@[simp] theorem swapDensity_localPairABBlock {ιA ιB : Type*}
    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    swapDensity (localPairABBlock X) =
      localPairBABlock (heterogeneousSwapDensity X) := by
  ext x y
  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩
  rcases y with ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
  cases x₁ <;> cases x₂ <;> cases y₁ <;> cases y₂ <;>
    simp [swapDensity, localPairABBlock, localPairBABlock, heterogeneousSwapDensity]

@[simp] theorem swapDensity_localPairBABlock_heterogeneousSwapDensity {ιA ιB : Type*}
    (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ιA × ιB)) :
    swapDensity (localPairBABlock (heterogeneousSwapDensity X)) =
      localPairABBlock X := by
  ext x y
  rcases x with ⟨x₁, x₂⟩

theorem Matrix.coe_mulVecLin [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n R) :
    (M.mulVecLin : _ → _) = M.mulVec := rfl

@[simp]
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_apply [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n R) (v : n → R) :
    M.mulVecLin v = M *ᵥ v :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_zero [Fintype n] : Matrix.mulVecLin (0 : Matrix m n R) = 0 :=
  LinearMap.ext zero_mulVec

@[simp]
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_add [Fintype n] (M N : Matrix m n R) :
    (M + N).mulVecLin = M.mulVecLin + N.mulVecLin :=
  LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ add_mulVec _ _ _

@[simp] theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_transpose [Fintype m] (M : Matrix m n R) :
    Mᵀ.mulVecLin = M.vecMulLinear := by
  ext; simp [mulVec_transpose]

@[simp] theorem Matrix.vecMulLinear_transpose [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n R) :
    Mᵀ.vecMulLinear = M.mulVecLin := by
  ext; simp [vecMul_transpose]

theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_submatrix [Fintype n] [Fintype l] (f₁ : m → k) (e₂ : n ≃ l)
    (M : Matrix k l R) :
    (M.submatrix f₁ e₂).mulVecLin = funLeft R R f₁ ∘ₗ M.mulVecLin ∘ₗ funLeft _ _ e₂.symm :=
  LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ submatrix_mulVec_equiv _ _ _ _

/-- A variant of `Matrix.mulVecLin_submatrix` that keeps around `LinearEquiv`s. -/
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_reindex [Fintype n] [Fintype l] (e₁ : k ≃ m) (e₂ : l ≃ n)
    (M : Matrix k l R) :
    (reindex e₁ e₂ M).mulVecLin =
      ↑(LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft R R e₁.symm) ∘ₗ
        M.mulVecLin ∘ₗ ↑(LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft R R e₂) :=
  Matrix.mulVecLin_submatrix _ _ _

variable [Fintype n]

@[simp]
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_one [DecidableEq n] :
    Matrix.mulVecLin (1 : Matrix n n R) = LinearMap.id := by
  ext; simp [Matrix.one_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

@[simp]
theorem Matrix.mulVecLin_mul [Fintype m] (M : Matrix l m R) (N : Matrix m n R) :
    Matrix.mulVecLin (M * N) = (Matrix.mulVecLin M).comp (Matrix.mulVecLin N) :=
  LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ (mulVec_mulVec _ _ _).symm

  rw [← A.sum_eq_total,
